playstyle.identity: Amumu is a tank jungler with two bandage tosses and a teamfight-winning ultimate. He's simple to play and excels at engaging on grouped enemies.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q has two charges for engaging or chasing. W toggles AoE tears around you. E deals damage and reduces cooldown when hit. R stuns all enemies around you. Q into a group, R, then W-E for massive AoE damage and CC.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Amumu spikes at level 6 with his AoE stun ultimate. Sunfire and tank items scale his damage and durability. He's strong in teamfights at all stages.

passive.name: Cursed Touch
passive.summary: Auto attacks curse enemies to take bonus true damage.
passive.details: Amumu's basic attacks curse enemies for a few seconds, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

abilities.name: Bandage Toss
abilities.summary: Throw a bandage that pulls you to the first enemy hit. Two charges.
abilities.details: Amumu throws out a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit and stunning them. Stores up to two charges.

abilities.name: Despair
abilities.summary: Toggle AoE tears that deal percent health magic damage around you.
abilities.details: Amumu cries, dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies based on their max health. Drains mana while active.

abilities.name: Tantrum
abilities.summary: Deal AoE damage around you; cooldown reduced when hit.
abilities.details: Amumu has a tantrum, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. Passively reduces physical damage taken, and the cooldown is reduced each time Amumu is hit.

abilities.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
abilities.summary: Stun all nearby enemies in a large area.
abilities.details: Amumu entangles all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage and stunning them. One of the best teamfight ultimates in the game.
